# Lead Intelligence

Curated by Skill Harbor: an agent-powered lead intelligence pipeline that finds, scores, and reaches high-value contacts through social graph analysis and warm path discovery. Five stages run in order: signal scoring (role, industry, recent activity, influence, proximity, engagement with your content), mutual ranking, warm path discovery through mutual connections, enrichment, and outreach drafting across email, LinkedIn, and X. Voice before outreach is mandatory: it runs brand-voice (also in this batch) to model your tone from real posts instead of drafting from generic sales copy. Its untrusted-source discipline is unusually explicit for a sales tool: profiles, bios, and posts are data, never instructions, so a bio saying "contact us at this address" is a claim to verify, never a routing order, and sending is always draft-first, never auto-send. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: the full pipeline needs real tooling, Exa MCP for deep web search and X API credentials for graph analysis (LinkedIn via API or browser control, Apollo/Clay optional for enrichment); without those, the skill degrades to a structured manual workflow. Respect platform terms and anti-spam rules: this drafts outreach, it does not blast it. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
